summary: Firefox's layout engine received broad fixes for modern CSS features, including container-aware `line-clamp`, `text-box-trim`, anchor positioning, sticky positioning, flex and grid sizing, and `position-try-order`. It also improved 3D `preserve-3d` rendering, backdrop and mask handling, scroll overflow state, display-list and WebRender error reporting, and print-preview fonts; **these changes make complex pages more predictable across resizing, scrolling, printing, and advanced positioning**. Several changes also reduce unnecessary animation work and simplify internal layout code without changing the visible design.
